name: conversation-ec-only
description: Out-of-order conversation in both directions produced by the oracle, with the post-quantum ratchet state removed from both parties after establishment so that message keys use no HKDF salt. Deployed peers never send or accept such messages (a missing post-quantum field is rejected); these vectors exist to test the EC Double Ratchet, message-key expansion, AES-256-CBC and MAC exactly. initial_state is read from oracle state. Each send event lists the sender state used and the derived keys; the generator checked each derived key by decrypting the body and recomputing the MAC. Deliver events list the oracle receiver outcome, in order.
